# Test media

Media the visual tests (`strata-visual.config.ts`, `tests/visual/`) import into the editor: one morning's
trail run, as a person would bring it. Everything here is generated by
[`scripts/fixtures/make-media.mjs`](../../../scripts/fixtures/make-media.mjs) from code in this repository
(no footage, music or map data from anywhere else), so it is ours to commit and to change. Total about
2.4 MB, which is why it is committed rather than generated on each run (generating takes about four
minutes and needs ffmpeg).

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ridge-loop.gpx` | The activity: a 6.4 km loop with 226 m of climb, 38.5 minutes, 1,156 points every 2 s, exported in Garmin's shape (`gpxtpx:hr` and `gpxtpx:cad` per point, `trail_running`). Pace slows on the climb and the runner walks the steep part (cadence drops to the 50s), heart rate follows the effort, positions wander by a few metres as GPS does. |
| `GX010412.MP4` | 8 s of chest-camera footage on the valley lane (0.45 km in): tarmac, dry-stone walls, fields, trees. |
| `GX010413.MP4` | 8 s climbing a path through the woods (1.43 km in): close trunks, dappled light, birds. |
| `GX010414.MP4` | 6 s on the open ridge top (3.43 km in): moor, a stony path, fence posts, wind on the microphone. |
| `valley-floor.mp3` | A 20 s music bed (A minor, F, C, G at 120 bpm) to lay under the footage. |
| `IMG_2231.jpg` | A 1600×1200 phone photo from the ridge. The library does not take images, so this is the file it refuses. |
| `clips.json` | Where and when each clip was filmed on the route (time, distance, position, height), for tests that check sync. |

The clips are what a GoPro writes: H.264 High profile and AAC in MP4, 640×360 at 25 fps (smaller than a
camera's 1080p to keep the repository small), named `GX01nnnn.MP4`, with `creation_time` set to the
moment on the GPX track they were filmed, so footage and route agree. The picture is drawn by
`scripts/fixtures/scene.mjs`: a ground plane in perspective with sky, cloud, hills and sprites, filmed by
a camera that bobs at the runner's cadence and sways with the stride, with grain, vignette and a short
motion smear. The sound (`scripts/fixtures/sound.mjs`) has footfalls on the same beat as the bob,
breathing every two steps, wind and birds.

The valley is invented (`scripts/fixtures/terrain.mjs`): one elevation function gives the GPX its
`<ele>` values and the visual tests' map tiles (`tests/visual/tiles.mjs`) their contours and woods, so the
route on the map climbs across the contour lines it was run over. It sits at the Peak District's latitude
so speeds and distances read like a British fell run; the map is not of a real place.

To regenerate (everything is seeded, so the pictures and sound come out the same; encoders may differ by
a byte between ffmpeg versions):

```sh
node scripts/fixtures/make-media.mjs          # all of it
node scripts/fixtures/make-media.mjs gpx lane # only some: gpx, lane, woods, ridge, photo, music
```

Then update the visual baselines and look at what changed.
